english.note: A speaker uses this when focusing on the bank or ATM card used to withdraw money, even when it also functions as a debit card.

examples.english: I’m going to withdraw money at the ATM, so remember to bring the debit card.
examples.traditional: 我去櫃員機提款，記得帶埋提款卡。
